gemma2:9b.title: Rumi
gemma2:9b.explanation: A collection of profound poetry and mystical insights by Jalāl al-Dīn Rūmī, exploring themes of love, spirituality, and the connection between the human soul and the divine. This work invites readers to embark on a journey of self-discovery and enlightenment.

gemma2:9b.title: Masnavi: Book One
gemma2:9b.explanation: The first book of Rumi's epic poem, exploring themes of love, loss, and spiritual awakening.

gemma2:9b.title: Rumi: One-Handed Basket Weaving : Poems on the Theme of Work
gemma2:9b.explanation: This collection of poems by Jalāl al-Dīn Rūmī explores the theme of work through a spiritual lens, blending profound insights with the beauty of craftsmanship. Rūmī's verses encourage readers to find meaning and connection in their labor, highlighting the transformative power of dedication and creativity.
